Bicalutamide: daily anti-androgen tabletsNational Cancer Control Programme (NCCP) 00482

One review per page. Each medicine has its own symptom table. Mark the worst symptoms since your last review, when they occurred and what they stopped you doing. Overlapping symptoms can be recorded under more than one medicine; you do not have to identify the cause.

These are patient-language severity prompts, not a validated questionnaire or a formal Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) grading tool. Your team assigns the clinical grade. Serious symptoms override the columns: call without waiting to decide a severity level.
Use a new record sheet for each cycle or review. Copy or print another sheet when needed; the number of sheets does not prescribe the length of treatment.
Record the actual dose, any held tablets and review dates; the boxes do not define a treatment course.
Bicalutamide 50 mg treatment review · copy this sheet for the next review.
□ Tiredness improves with rest
□ Rest does not help; usual tasks affected: call
□ Self-care difficult: urgent review
□ Queasy but eating and drinking
□ Intake reduced: contact the team

□ Collapse / severe dehydration: 112/999
□ Persistent diarrhoea / constipation: call
□ Blood, severe pain or dehydration: urgent review
□ Collapse or severe sudden illness: 112/999
□ New small change: report
□ Persistent rash / itch: contact team
□ Painful, spreading or blistering rash: urgent review
□ Severe skin reaction with acute illness: emergency help
□ New palpitations: contact team promptly
□ Palpitations with dizziness: urgent assessment
□ Chest pain or fainting: emergency assessment
□ Severe chest pain, collapse or breathing difficulty: 112/999

Temperature 37.5°C or higher, 36°C or lower, shivering or suddenly feeling unwell — even with a normal temperature. Call your team promptly for new or worsening symptoms. New leg weakness, loss of bladder or bowel control, severe chest pain, severe breathing difficulty, collapse or a seizure needs emergency assessment: call 112/999. Blistering or peeling skin, mouth or eye sores, or a severe headache with vision changes needs urgent medical assessment.

Follow the urgent contact instructions from your treating hospital. If you cannot reach the team, seek urgent medical assessment. Outside clinic hours, use your instructed out-of-hours pathway or the emergency department.
This page does not diagnose symptoms or decide whether it is safe to stay at home. You do not need to know which medicine caused a symptom before calling.
Lower testosterone to help control prostate cancer. Your team explains whether the goal is cancer control or part of a plan that includes radiotherapy.

Leuprorelin initially stimulates the pituitary gland. Continued stimulation then reduces its signal to the testes, so testosterone falls. This explains both the early flare risk and sustained hormone suppression between injections.

Niraparib inhibits PARP proteins used in DNA repair. BRCA-altered cancer already has a weakness in another repair pathway, making this additional block more damaging to cancer cells. Abiraterone reduces androgen production by blocking CYP17. Prednisolone limits the hormone imbalance caused by that block.
PSA helps assess cancer activity. Testosterone tests check hormone suppression. Symptoms, results and scans are reviewed together; there is no single scan interval for everyone.
Discuss expected benefit, uncertainty, side effects and alternatives, including supportive care and declining treatment. Choose a plan that reflects your priorities.
Trial results describe groups of people; they cannot predict an individual outcome.

At the primary analysis, median time without scan progression or death was 16.6 versus 10.9 months; hazard ratio 0.533 (95% CI 0.361-0.789). Final overall-survival HR was 0.788 (95% CI 0.554-1.120), which did not establish an overall-survival advantage. The progression and survival analyses used different data cut-offs. These figures are not an individual prediction.
